name: Boutonnière Deformity
definition: Finger deformity caused by central-slip extensor dysfunction, producing PIP flexion and DIP hyperextension.

typical: History of jammed finger or inflammatory arthritis

core: Elson test in acute suspected injury

investigations.principle: Clinical diagnosis is central; radiographs exclude avulsion fracture/dislocation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Early extension splinting for appropriate acute injury
amber: Chronic fixed deformity may need reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Finger deformity caused by central-slip extensor dysfunction, producing PIP flexion and DIP hyperextension.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
